# Table of best-known minimal lattice lengths, SC lattice, prime knots ≤ 10 crossings

*Generated by `wiki/tools/build_tables.py` — edit the CSVs, not this file.*

Sources: Len upper bound S, number E of canonical minimal polygons found, number C of type-0 (length-preserving BFACF) classes — [Scharein09] Table A1; lattice stick upper bound — [Scharein09] Table A2; P_K (minimal polygons up to translation, both chiralities) — [JvRR11] Table 3 where computed. Polygons realising every S: `data/rechnitzer_SC_minimal.csv` (re-verified in this project, see `READING_LIST.md` §1).

**Status:** only 3_1 (24), 4_1 (30), 5_1 (34) are exact; every other S is a numerical **upper bound** ([Scharein09] §1). E and C are lower bounds on the true counts ("not an exhaustive enumeration", [Scharein09] §5.3). The knot numbering follows [Scharein09] (10_1 … 10_165).

Lattice stick column: `a→b` means the minimum over minimal-length polygons is a, and a separate stick-minimising search found b = a − k (the superscript k of Table A2).
